prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Camera on the wet cobbles at the kerb, the same corner as the opening. The street is empty at night: a black 1920s sedan stands abandoned with its doors open, banknotes blowing out across the cobbles, a dropped fedora in the foreground. Light: one streetlamp, a red lamp over a doorway, lit tenement windows; above the rooftops a small red moon. The soaked cobbles carry every light as long streaks. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
